entries.alt: An older gray-bearded shepherd holds a staff and reaches an open hand toward sheep gathered inside a stone sheepfold.
entries.caption: A shepherd turns toward the sheep at the open fold. His attentive call pictures the familiar voice and personal care Jesus describes in His teaching.
entries.findings: Hands, staff grip, head direction and sheep are coherent; sheep attend the shepherd. Natural age, skin, wool and cloth. Distinct unnamed older man, not approved Christ likeness.
conditions: Illustrates the shepherd calling in John 10:3, not a literal portrait of Christ or an authenticated location.
Technical acceptance is not owner approval or browser verification.

entries.alt: A young man runs from a scattered flock while looking back toward a gray wolf approaching across rocky grassland.
entries.caption: The hired worker runs as danger approaches, leaving the sheep behind. Jesus contrasts this flight with the care of the good shepherd.
entries.findings: Plausible running limbs and anxious backward gaze toward threat; wolf separated from flock, no contact or injury. Distinct sheep, coherent wool and legs; natural daylight and skin texture.
conditions: Illustrative hired worker and wolf in John 10:12, not a named person or documented historical attack.
Technical acceptance is not owner approval or browser verification.

entries.alt: A thick leafy branch grows from the weathered trunk of a grapevine in a stony vineyard.
entries.caption: A living branch remains joined to the vine. Jesus uses this simple relationship to teach His disciples about abiding in Him.
entries.findings: Organic connected trunk and lateral branch with plausible bark, leaf veins and smaller shoots. Photographic light and depth. No harvest action, supernatural symbols or literal divine figure.
conditions: Botanical illustration of John 15:1-5, not literal depiction of Christ or the Father.
Technical acceptance is not owner approval or browser verification.
